revenue.source: Costco 10-K FY2025 (acc. 0000909832-25-000101) income statement, total revenue

d_and_a.source: Costco 10-K FY2025 cash flow statement, depreciation and amortization

capex.source: Costco 10-K FY2025 cash flow, additions to property and equipment

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 8.2% and FY2024 5.0%; fading from ~8% to 6% on comps plus ~25-30 net new warehouses/yr, law of large numbers.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held near FY2025 actual 3.77% (10,383/275,235); FY2023 3.35%, FY2024 3.65%, so modest stability with no further expansion.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. normalized effective rate (US federal 21% plus state/foreign, net of credits); not verified against the 10-K tax note - reviewer to confirm.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Company guidance in FY2025 10-K of $6.0-6.5bn capex for FY2026 (~2.1% of ~$297bn revenue); FY2025 actual 2.0%.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with ~4.3% risk-free, beta ~0.9-1.0, ERP ~5%, negligible debt weight gives ~7-8%; 7.5% chosen. Not sourced from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: approx. long-run nominal GDP/inflation, below WACC; rationale judgment-based.

net_debt.source: Costco 10-K FY2025 (0000909832-25-000101): total debt 5,788 (current portion 75 + long-term excl. current 5,713; leases excluded) minus cash 14,161 minus short-term investments 1,123 (Q4 FY2025 press release, 8-K 0000909832-25-000093). Negative = net cash.

diluted_shares.source: Costco 10-K FY2025 weighted average diluted shares 444,803 thousand, converted to millions.
